sensors_head.value: stereo RGB + depth cameras, mics/speakers for operator telepresence

sensors_wrist_hand.value: haptic feedback relayed to VR operator

compute.value: edge AI onboard + cloud; 5G / WiFi 6 low-latency link

safety_compliance.value: no ISO cert published; vendor claims only humanoid legally usable in German domestic settings; soft flexible skin, operator-in-loop
